---
title: Registration and student portal
toc: false
---

Register with your **email address and a one-time code**. Sign in without a password. Use the same email when returning to the course portal.

```{=html}
<div class="portal-steps" aria-label="Registration steps">
  <span>1 · Verify email</span><span>2 · Register</span><span>3 · Stay signed in on your device</span>
</div>
<section class="portal-panel" aria-labelledby="portal-heading">
  <h2 id="portal-heading">Join the course</h2>
  <p id="portal-status" role="status" aria-live="polite">Registration opens soon. Please check back for the opening announcement.</p>
  <noscript><p>JavaScript is needed for registration. Course materials remain available without signing in.</p></noscript>
  <form id="email-form">
    <fieldset id="email-fields" disabled>
      <legend>Verify your email</legend>
      <label for="email">Email address</label>
      <input id="email" name="email" type="email" autocomplete="email" maxlength="254" required>
      <label class="portal-checkbox" for="remember-device"><input id="remember-device" type="checkbox" checked aria-describedby="remember-help"> Keep me signed in on this device</label>
      <p id="remember-help" class="portal-hint">Uncheck this on shared computers. You can sign out at any time.</p>
      <button class="btn btn-primary" id="send-code" type="submit">Email me a sign-in code</button>
    </fieldset>
  </form>
  <form id="code-form" hidden>
    <fieldset id="code-fields">
      <legend>Enter your email code</legend>
      <p id="code-recipient"></p>
      <label for="code">One-time code</label>
      <input id="code" name="code" type="text" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="one-time-code" pattern="[0-9]{6,10}" minlength="6" maxlength="10" required>
      <button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">Verify email</button>
      <button class="btn btn-outline-primary" id="change-email" type="button">Use another email</button>
    </fieldset>
  </form>
  <form id="profile-form">
    <fieldset id="profile-fields" disabled>
      <legend>Your registration</legend>
      <div class="portal-name-grid">
        <div><label for="first-name">First name (given name)</label><input id="first-name" name="first-name" autocomplete="given-name" maxlength="100" required></div>
        <div><label for="last-name">Second name (family name)</label><input id="last-name" name="last-name" autocomplete="family-name" maxlength="100" required></div>
      </div>
      <label for="programme">Programme and year</label>
      <select id="programme" name="programme" required>
        <option value="">Select your programme and year</option>
        <option value="master_1">Master year 1</option>
        <option value="master_2">Master year 2</option>
        <option value="phd_1">PhD year 1</option>
        <option value="phd_2">PhD year 2</option>
        <option value="phd_3">PhD year 3</option>
      </select>
      <label for="verified-email">Verified email address</label>
      <input id="verified-email" name="verified-email" type="email" readonly aria-describedby="email-note">
      <p id="email-note" class="portal-hint">Your verified email identifies your account. Use the same address on future visits.</p>
      <button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">Save registration</button>
    </fieldset>
  </form>
  <button class="btn btn-outline-primary" type="button" id="sign-out" hidden>Sign out</button>
</section>
<section class="portal-panel" aria-labelledby="future-heading">
  <h2 id="future-heading">Your future course workspace</h2>
  <div class="portal-name-grid">
    <div><h3>Final project</h3><p>Submission opens later in the course. Sign in to submit your final project.</p></div>
    <div><h3>Questionnaires</h3><p>Questionnaires will appear here when available. Each will explain whether responses are identified or anonymous.</p></div>
  </div>
</section>
<script type="module" src="assets/portal.mjs"></script>
```

## Staying signed in

With **Keep me signed in** selected, the browser will remember your session and refresh it automatically. On a shared computer, uncheck it and sign out when finished. Clearing browser storage, signing out, or an expired or revoked session may require a new email code. Private browsing may not retain your session.

## About your registration

Course registration will ask for your name, programme/year, and verified email. Your details will be stored privately for course administration. Please also complete the university’s official enrollment process.

Data-handling information will be available when registration opens. For course questions, contact [Yaolang Zhong](mailto:yaolang.zhong@e.u-tokyo.ac.jp).
